title: When State Disaster Response Fails w/ Dr. Nadine Ortega
author: CounterPunch Radio
content:
In this episode of CounterPunch Radio, Rebecca Maria Goldschmidt speaks with
Dr. Nadine Ortega, co-founder of Tagnawa Hawai'i, about grassroots mutual aid
disaster recovery. Dr. Ortega breaks down the socio-economic and historical
conditions that have led to the recent Kona Low flooding on O'ahu and the 2023
Lahaina, Maui fires, which have disproportionately affected Native Hawaiian,
Filipino, and other immigrant communities. She shares stories about the
importance of cross-class and interethnic organizing when state-run disaster
response fails.

Visit [Tagnawa.org](https://www.tagnawa.org/) for more information.
